label: prop:categorical-neutron-exists
title: Existence of the categorical neutron
html:
The categorical neutron exists as a well-defined, LP-stable element of the Hecke algebra H_3(q):

\mathfrak{n} = \mathcal{B}_3(\mathfrak{u}, \mathfrak{d}, \mathfrak{d}) \in H_3(q).

Archimedean specialisation. What follows sits on the archimedean side of the substrate wall. It invokes real-valued physical observables, real-analytic bounds, transcendental constants, or numerical evaluation at the substrate parameter q_0. The categorical identities hold over an abstract coefficient ring. Only the archimedean realization requires specialization.
